title: Cross-adapter auto-log hook for spawns.json — design only, not built now
detail: Extends d4 (hooks skipped). Design: claude-code SubagentStop/PostToolUse(Task) hook -> resolve-spawn.py maps subagent_type -> tier -> config.json adapter block -> {adapter,model,level}, appends a row; matching SessionStart/SessionEnd hook emits the coordinator row. opencode: same resolver via opencode.json plugin/hook mechanism. codex: degraded mode, no subagents to capture -- only session-level (coordinator/role) events loggable via notify; per-subagent capture is N/A, document the asymmetry rather than faking rows. Resolver logic is shared; only the wiring differs per adapter.
outcome: built for claude-code: single PostToolUse hook (matcher "Agent") on flywheel/resolve-spawn.py does notify+log in one pass, using tool_response.resolvedModel as ground truth; coordinator row remains manual at wrapup (SessionEnd payload carries no model). opencode: stub written (adapters/opencode/plugin/spawn-log.ts), Pending verification. codex: NOT N/A after all -- docs/research/codex-hooks.md (fetched 2026-07-08) shows codex documents SubagentStart/SubagentStop hook events with agent_id/agent_type, so per-spawn capture is possible via a SubagentStop hook using the same shared resolver; deferred pending a live codex session to verify exact trigger wording and the hooks.json skeleton.
